{{Quote|A somewhat disoriented youth came out of the nearby Snapping Septoid entertainment facility. When he saw us looking at the speeder, he began shouting and pushed us away.|Investigating officer Wets Tranoj|<ref name="HoloNetNews" />}}
The '''Snapping Septoid''' was an entertainment facility located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] stole the [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] and parked it around the vicinity of the Snapping Septoid. [[Reymet Autem]], a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who exited the entertainment facility, was placed into custody for the theft by Coruscanti officials. 

==Description==
The Snapping Septoid was an entertainment facility<ref name="HoloNetNews" /> popular with breathers of [[Methane/Legends|methane]] and those with inclinations to loving [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].<ref name="FF44" /> The facility was located on<ref name="FF44" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="FF44" /> nearby [[Vos Gesal Street/Legends|Vos Gesal Street]]<ref name="HoloNetNews" /> in the planet's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]. The district also featured the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="FF44" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWEOutlander">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> that the Snapping Septoid was directly across from.<ref name="FF44" /> The facility partially shared its name with<ref name="HoloNetNews" /> [[Septoid/Legends|septoids]], [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] creatures [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="CSWESeptoid">{{CSWECite|III|139|septoid}}</ref>

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] stole<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade's]] [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|one-of-a-kind airspeeder]]<ref name="HoloNetNews" /> on Coruscant as he went in pursuit of fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="AOTC" /> The speeder was eventually parked on Vos Gesal Street and tracked down. As Coruscanti officials investigated the scene, the young [[Gender/Legends|man]] [[Reymet Autem]] exited the Snapping Septoid and began shouting at them. Autem was then placed into custody<ref name="HoloNetNews" /> despite not being the actual thief.<ref name="AOTC" /> On the date 13:5:16, [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported on the event and mentioned the Snapping Septoid in its coverage via a quote from investigating officer [[Wets Tranoj]].<ref name="HoloNetNews" />   

==Behind the scenes==
The Snapping Septoid was first mentioned<ref name="HoloNetNews" /> on [[May 16]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN56 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6873383|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=ForceAlly|date=2002-05-16|time=5:34 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> with the release of [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 56|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #56'']], an issue published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website<ref name="HoloNetNews" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
